messages:
taylor (sales): Heads-up: Vanguard AI POC hitting cascading 429s and occasional 502s during their stress run. Customer demo in 12 hrs. Can eng/sre/solutions jump in? Need temporary mitigation + whether Dedicated should be suggested.

ryan (solutions): On it. How many parallel clients and which model are they using? Any full request examples?

taylor (sales): They launched 60 concurrent agents hitting chat.generate with seqs ~800 tokens. Using redwood-13b-chat default. Sample errors: 

```
{"status":429, "message":"quota_exceeded", "org":"vanguard-poc"}
{"status":502, "message":"backend_unavail", "detail":"failed to allocate kernel"}
```

leah (acctmgr): For Dedicated: provisioning lead-time is typically 48-72h for new trials, can sometimes fast-track to 24h. I'll assemble ballpark pricing. For demo today we should try to stabilize hosted stack.

oncall-sre: I see a sharp spike in active connections for that org and increased kernel CPU time. Several worker pods restarted due to OOM. Paging eng-runtime.

jess (eng-runtime): Likely root causes: long context + aggressive parallelism -> KV cache pressure and more memory per request. Short-term fixes we can do: 1) apply per-org request caps (max_tokens=700), 2) route them to a smaller model shard (13b -> 7b) for the demo, 3) temporarily bump soft QPS limit for the org. Which do we want first?

ryan (solutions): Recommend tiered approach: start with token cap + QPS bump, then fallback plan to model downgrade if load persists. Also send them client guidance for backoff.

taylor (sales): Customer prefers fidelity but will accept slightly shorter responses for demo. Please proceed with token cap and QPS bump. Also they asked about data residency and KMS for Dedicated. Who can confirm?

leah (acctmgr): We support customer-managed KMS in Dedicated and VPC peering for private deployments. I'll pull the compliance pack and share the Confluence link here.

jess (eng-runtime): I'll roll a per-org transform to inject `max_tokens:700` and add `x-suggested-backoff:200` header for 429s. Deploying now. Tagging @oncall-sre for approval.

oncall-sre: Approve for short window. Please include a timestamped audit log and a rollback toggle. I'll also raise the org soft-limit by 30% for 3 hours.

deploy-bot: [deploy] Deploying infra/request-transform v1.7 -> 2 instances. CI ok. Canary start. ETA ~6m.

ryan (solutions): While that deploy runs, ping the customer to add jittered exponential backoff in their client and consider streaming partial responses to reduce perceived latency. Provide sample code snippet.

taylor (sales): Message sent to Vanguard: ask them to enable client retry + streaming for demo. They confirmed they can accept shorter answers.

deploy-bot: [deploy] Canary complete. request-transform v1.7 live on edge nodes.

jess (eng-runtime): Transform is live. Max tokens enforced and backoff header present. Watching for error spikes.

oncall-sre: Soft QPS bump applied at 22:18 UTC. Early indicators: request queue depth decreasing. A few 502s remain; looks like two pods still flapping due to OOM during heavy ops. I'm restarting those pods with slightly higher mem limits as emergency patch.

ryan (solutions): Sidelined idea: for certain flows we can replace full generation with an embedding-based rerank and a short template response to cut compute. I'll prepare a 2-slide explanation for Vanguard.

leah (acctmgr): I'll prep Dedicated trial estimate and include KMS/VPC options. Also flagging that enterprise contract may need SOC2 addendum.

jess (eng-runtime): After the restart, worker stability improved. Latencies: p50 ~480ms, p95 ~1.2s, error rate ~0.8%. Customer ran demo smoke and says core scenarios are OK.

taylor (sales): Great. Customer wants a follow-up call after the demo to discuss Dedicated for prod. Please assemble postmortem notes and a short migration checklist.

oncall-sre: Will capture timeline in incidents board. jess/ryan please provide RCA bullets (OOM cause, tokens, KV cache warmup).

ryan (solutions): I'll document client mitigations and recommended model fallback list (13b -> 7b -> 3b) and provide sample config.

jess (eng-runtime): I'll add kernel OOM root cause notes and the config change details (transform version, rollback steps).

leah (acctmgr): I'll draft the Dedicated quote and attach security compliance docs.

taylor (sales): Thanks team. Closing this thread; re-open if something else crops up before the demo. :white_check_mark:
